senses.gloss: स्नु SNU, Ⅱ. P. snaúti, emit fluid, yield 🞄milk: pp. snuta, flowing (esp. of the maternal 🞄breast). pra, emit fluid, drip: pp. 🞄yielding milk.
स्नु snú, n. [= sānu] surface, height (V.).

स्नुषा snuṣā́, f. daughter-in-law: -ga, a. 🞄having sexual intercourse with a daughter-inlaw;
 🞄-tva, n. condition of a daughter-in-law.
स्नुह् snuh, f. (nm. k) a plant (wolfʼs milk): 🞄-ā, -ī, f. id..
